items.title: UI Screenshot System
items.summary: High-fidelity app, web, dashboard, and social interface prompts. / 生成 App、网页、仪表盘、社媒截图等高保真界面。
items.prompt:
Style Template: UI Screenshot System

Use when: Use for app screens, dashboards, social screenshots, and live interface mockups.

Prompt recipe:
- Lock platform, aspect ratio, layout hierarchy, and exact visible text.
- Specify UI chrome such as status bars, tabs, action rows, or comment layers.

Avoid:
- Avoid vague platform names and generic app mockups.
- Constrain text readability and platform-specific details.
guidance: Lock platform, aspect ratio, layout hierarchy, and exact visible text.
Specify UI chrome such as status bars, tabs, action rows, or comment layers.
guidanceZh: 锁定平台、比例、层级和画面文字。
明确状态栏、Tab、操作区、评论层等 UI 元素。
pitfalls: Avoid vague platform names and generic app mockups.
Constrain text readability and platform-specific details.

items.title: Infographic Engine
items.summary: Structured diagrams, timelines, knowledge maps, and explainers. / 生成结构化图解、时间线、知识图谱和技术解释图。
items.prompt:
Style Template: Infographic Engine

Use when: Use for explainer graphics, technical diagrams, timelines, and knowledge cards.

Prompt recipe:
- Define 3-5 modules, information flow, visual hierarchy, and short labels.
- Use color groups, arrows, icons, and clean spacing to reduce clutter.

Avoid:
- Avoid long paragraphs inside the image.
- Limit module count before adding visual detail.
guidance: Define 3-5 modules, information flow, visual hierarchy, and short labels.
Use color groups, arrows, icons, and clean spacing to reduce clutter.
guidanceZh: 定义 3-5 个模块、信息流、层级和短标签。
用色块、箭头、图标和留白控制复杂度。
pitfalls: Avoid long paragraphs inside the image.
Limit module count before adding visual detail.

items.title: Scientific Scale Diagram
items.summary: Multi-scale science visuals with readable labels and hierarchy. / 生成多尺度科学信息图，强调层级、标签和可读性。
items.prompt:
Style Template: Scientific Scale Diagram

Use when: Use when the topic needs micro-to-macro scale comparison and labeled detail windows.

Prompt recipe:
- Use 6-8 scale frames and keep each label short.
- Show units, magnification, and distinct scale detail.

Avoid:
- Avoid making every scale frame visually identical.
- Avoid generic magnifying glass icon layouts.
guidance: Use 6-8 scale frames and keep each label short.
Show units, magnification, and distinct scale detail.
guidanceZh: 使用 6-8 个尺度框，每个标签保持短句。
展示单位、倍率和不同尺度的细节。
pitfalls: Avoid making every scale frame visually identical.
Avoid generic magnifying glass icon layouts.

items.title: Poster Layout System
items.summary: Event, product, movie, and social poster compositions. / 生成活动、产品、电影和社媒传播海报。
items.prompt:
Style Template: Poster Layout System

Use when: Use for event posters, movie posters, covers, and social campaign visuals.

Prompt recipe:
- Lock subject, headline, layout, palette, and aspect ratio.
- Make the title hierarchy and primary visual clear.

Avoid:
- Avoid mixed moodboards or process sheets when asking for one finished poster.
- Constrain extra text and decorative symbols.
guidance: Lock subject, headline, layout, palette, and aspect ratio.
Make the title hierarchy and primary visual clear.
guidanceZh: 锁定主体、标题、版式、配色和比例。
突出标题层级和主视觉。
pitfalls: Avoid mixed moodboards or process sheets when asking for one finished poster.
Constrain extra text and decorative symbols.

items.title: Sports Campaign Poster
items.summary: Commercial sports visuals with athletes, props, and brand color. / 生成运动员、道具、品牌色统一的商业运动海报。
items.prompt:
Style Template: Sports Campaign Poster

Use when: Use for sports brand campaigns, athlete posters, and product-led sport visuals.

Prompt recipe:
- Define sport, athlete pose, hero prop, title, and brand palette.
- Use dramatic light, clean composition, and readable data overlays.

Avoid:
- Avoid wrong equipment and noisy collage.
- Keep the athlete and hero prop visually dominant.
guidance: Define sport, athlete pose, hero prop, title, and brand palette.
Use dramatic light, clean composition, and readable data overlays.
guidanceZh: 定义运动项目、姿态、核心道具、标题和品牌色。
使用强光影、干净构图和可读数据层。
pitfalls: Avoid wrong equipment and noisy collage.
Keep the athlete and hero prop visually dominant.

items.title: Conceptual Typography Poster
items.summary: Premium title-led posters with strong typographic systems. / 生成以标题文字为主视觉的高级字体海报。
items.prompt:
Style Template: Conceptual Typography Poster

Use when: Use when the exact title must become the main visual structure.

Prompt recipe:
- Make typography the hero and spell the title exactly.
- Tie human figures, objects, or landscapes to the title meaning.

Avoid:
- Avoid default word art, unrelated icons, and misspelled title text.
- Limit the color system to a restrained palette.
guidance: Make typography the hero and spell the title exactly.
Tie human figures, objects, or landscapes to the title meaning.
guidanceZh: 让字体成为画面主角，并保证标题拼写准确。
人物、物体或风景需要服务标题含义。
pitfalls: Avoid default word art, unrelated icons, and misspelled title text.
Limit the color system to a restrained palette.

items.title: Ink Double Exposure Poster
items.summary: Chinese ink, portrait, and layered atmosphere composition. / 生成水墨、人像与层叠氛围结合的视觉海报。
items.prompt:
Style Template: Ink Double Exposure Poster

Use when: Use for poetic portrait posters, ink atmospheres, and layered cultural visuals.

Prompt recipe:
- Blend portrait silhouette, ink texture, atmosphere, and negative space.
- Keep composition quiet, premium, and readable.

Avoid:
- Avoid cheap fantasy collage and overloaded scenery.
- Use subtle text or no text unless required.
guidance: Blend portrait silhouette, ink texture, atmosphere, and negative space.
Keep composition quiet, premium, and readable.
guidanceZh: 融合人像剪影、水墨质感、氛围和留白。
保持构图克制、高级、可读。
pitfalls: Avoid cheap fantasy collage and overloaded scenery.
Use subtle text or no text unless required.

items.title: Nature Science Poster
items.summary: Minimal product-style science posters for natural subjects. / 生成极简产品感自然科普海报。
items.prompt:
Style Template: Nature Science Poster

Use when: Use for natural subjects that need a premium, clean science poster feel.

Prompt recipe:
- Use a clear subject, minimal copy, soft shadows, and disciplined whitespace.
- Keep the scientific label short and visible.

Avoid:
- Avoid heavy advertising language.
- Avoid dense encyclopedia blocks.
guidance: Use a clear subject, minimal copy, soft shadows, and disciplined whitespace.
Keep the scientific label short and visible.
guidanceZh: 使用清晰主体、少量文案、柔和阴影和充足留白。
让科普标签短而清楚。
pitfalls: Avoid heavy advertising language.
Avoid dense encyclopedia blocks.

items.title: Product Commerce Visual
items.summary: Product shots, packaging, detail pages, and selling-point layouts. / 生成商品图、包装、详情页和卖点排版。
items.prompt:
Style Template: Product Commerce Visual

Use when: Use for product hero shots, packaging visuals, detail pages, and sales layouts.

Prompt recipe:
- Define product, selling points, material, scene, lighting, and layout blocks.
- Separate hero product, benefit labels, and supporting props.

Avoid:
- Avoid random props that weaken product recognition.
- Constrain packaging text and claim wording.
guidance: Define product, selling points, material, scene, lighting, and layout blocks.
Separate hero product, benefit labels, and supporting props.
guidanceZh: 定义商品、卖点、材质、场景、光线和版块。
区分主商品、卖点标签和辅助道具。
pitfalls: Avoid random props that weaken product recognition.
Constrain packaging text and claim wording.

items.title: Personalized Beauty Report
items.summary: Recommendation-report layouts for beauty and lifestyle products. / 生成美妆与生活方式产品的推荐报告版式。
items.prompt:
Style Template: Personalized Beauty Report

Use when: Use for beauty recommendations, skin reports, shopping assistants, and lifestyle product cards.

Prompt recipe:
- Use a report-like hierarchy with diagnosis, recommendation, and product cards.
- Keep product images, labels, and ratings aligned.

Avoid:
- Avoid medical claims and unreadable dense notes.
- Keep recommendation logic simple.
guidance: Use a report-like hierarchy with diagnosis, recommendation, and product cards.
Keep product images, labels, and ratings aligned.
guidanceZh: 使用诊断、推荐和商品卡片的报告层级。
对齐商品图、标签和评分。
pitfalls: Avoid medical claims and unreadable dense notes.
Keep recommendation logic simple.

items.title: Brand Identity Package
items.summary: Logo, palette, typography, applications, and brand touchpoints. / 生成 Logo、配色、字体、应用触点与品牌系统。
items.prompt:
Style Template: Brand Identity Package

Use when: Use for logo systems, brand boards, visual identity kits, and application mockups.

Prompt recipe:
- Define brand name, positioning, palette, typography, logo usage, and touchpoints.
- Ask for a coherent board with aligned applications.

Avoid:
- Avoid unrelated logo variants and inconsistent palettes.
- Keep brand text accurate.
guidance: Define brand name, positioning, palette, typography, logo usage, and touchpoints.
Ask for a coherent board with aligned applications.
guidanceZh: 定义品牌名、定位、配色、字体、Logo 用法和触点。
要求视觉板中的应用统一对齐。
pitfalls: Avoid unrelated logo variants and inconsistent palettes.
Keep brand text accurate.

items.title: Brand Touchpoint Board
items.summary: Campaign boards across packaging, social, web, and display contexts. / 生成包装、社媒、网页和展示场景里的品牌触点板。
items.prompt:
Style Template: Brand Touchpoint Board

Use when: Use for multi-touchpoint campaign boards and brand rollout previews.

Prompt recipe:
- Specify touchpoint list, shared visual rules, and mockup arrangement.
- Use one palette and one typography logic across all panels.

Avoid:
- Avoid mixing many unrelated campaign styles.
- Limit touchpoints if readability drops.
guidance: Specify touchpoint list, shared visual rules, and mockup arrangement.
Use one palette and one typography logic across all panels.
guidanceZh: 指定触点清单、统一视觉规则和样机排列。
让所有面板共享配色和字体逻辑。
pitfalls: Avoid mixing many unrelated campaign styles.
Limit touchpoints if readability drops.

items.title: Architecture & Space
items.summary: Interior, exterior, city, map, and spatial concept visuals. / 生成室内、建筑、城市地图和空间概念视觉。
items.prompt:
Style Template: Architecture & Space

Use when: Use for interiors, architecture renders, city maps, spatial plans, and environment concepts.

Prompt recipe:
- Define viewpoint, scale, material, lighting, and spatial function.
- For maps, specify landmarks, labels, border decoration, and visual accuracy level.

Avoid:
- Avoid impossible perspectives unless the output is conceptual.
- Lock map label language and relative placement.
guidance: Define viewpoint, scale, material, lighting, and spatial function.
For maps, specify landmarks, labels, border decoration, and visual accuracy level.
guidanceZh: 定义视角、尺度、材质、光线和空间功能。
地图需要指定地标、标签、边框装饰和准确度。
pitfalls: Avoid impossible perspectives unless the output is conceptual.
Lock map label language and relative placement.

items.title: Realistic Photography
items.summary: Lens, lighting, film texture, and documentary-style photo prompts. / 控制镜头、光线、胶片质感和纪实摄影效果。
items.prompt:
Style Template: Realistic Photography

Use when: Use for portraits, street photos, product photography, and cinematic realism.

Prompt recipe:
- Specify camera distance, lens, light source, texture, background, and motion.
- Use believable imperfections for documentary realism.

Avoid:
- Avoid over-polished plastic skin unless commercial beauty is required.
- Add negative constraints for hands, text, and anatomy when needed.
guidance: Specify camera distance, lens, light source, texture, background, and motion.
Use believable imperfections for documentary realism.
guidanceZh: 指定机位、镜头、光源、质感、背景和动作。
加入可信的小瑕疵增强纪实感。
pitfalls: Avoid over-polished plastic skin unless commercial beauty is required.
Add negative constraints for hands, text, and anatomy when needed.

items.title: Street Accident Moment
items.summary: Realistic phone-photo scenes with negative constraints. / 生成手机纪实风街头瞬间，并加入负面约束。
items.prompt:
Style Template: Street Accident Moment

Use when: Use for candid street moments, accidental spills, documentary phone shots, and fast action.

Prompt recipe:
- Describe the exact moment, camera height, motion blur, and street context.
- Add negative constraints for staged poses and fake ad lighting.

Avoid:
- Avoid too-clean compositions.
- Keep the event plausible and grounded.
guidance: Describe the exact moment, camera height, motion blur, and street context.
Add negative constraints for staged poses and fake ad lighting.
guidanceZh: 描述具体瞬间、机位高度、运动模糊和街景。
加入避免摆拍和广告棚拍感的限制。
pitfalls: Avoid too-clean compositions.
Keep the event plausible and grounded.

items.title: Illustration & Art Style
items.summary: Anime, watercolor, ink, material experiments, and art direction. / 生成动漫、水彩、水墨、材质实验和艺术风格图。
items.prompt:
Style Template: Illustration & Art Style

Use when: Use for anime, watercolor, ink, decorative art, and style experiments.

Prompt recipe:
- Define composition, subject, palette, brush material, mood, and rendering depth.
- For reference images, state what must be preserved.

Avoid:
- Avoid style-only prompts without composition.
- Lock character identity when using references.
guidance: Define composition, subject, palette, brush material, mood, and rendering depth.
For reference images, state what must be preserved.
guidanceZh: 定义构图、主体、配色、笔触材质、情绪和完成度。
参考图任务需要说明保留哪些特征。
pitfalls: Avoid style-only prompts without composition.
Lock character identity when using references.

items.title: Character Design Sheet
items.summary: Characters, pose sheets, action grids, and identity consistency. / 生成角色设定、动作分解和一致性参考。
items.prompt:
Style Template: Character Design Sheet

Use when: Use for character sheets, pose grids, action breakdowns, and identity references.

Prompt recipe:
- Define identity anchors, outfit, proportions, pose count, and sheet layout.
- Keep face, hairstyle, and costume details consistent.

Avoid:
- Avoid changing costume details between poses.
- Limit pose count if the sheet becomes crowded.
guidance: Define identity anchors, outfit, proportions, pose count, and sheet layout.
Keep face, hairstyle, and costume details consistent.
guidanceZh: 定义身份锚点、服装、比例、动作数量和版式。
保持脸、发型和服装细节一致。
pitfalls: Avoid changing costume details between poses.
Limit pose count if the sheet becomes crowded.

items.title: 3D Collectible Toy
items.summary: Reference photo to premium 3D collectible figure prompts. / 把参考图转换成高级 3D 收藏玩具效果。
items.prompt:
Style Template: 3D Collectible Toy

Use when: Use for premium collectible figures, avatar toys, blind-box characters, and 3D display renders.

Prompt recipe:
- Preserve face and outfit anchors from the reference.
- Specify material, packaging, base, lighting, and collectible scale.

Avoid:
- Avoid generic toy bodies without identity details.
- Keep packaging text minimal and accurate.
guidance: Preserve face and outfit anchors from the reference.
Specify material, packaging, base, lighting, and collectible scale.
guidanceZh: 保留参考图中的脸和服装锚点。
指定材质、包装、底座、光线和收藏比例。
pitfalls: Avoid generic toy bodies without identity details.
Keep packaging text minimal and accurate.

items.title: Scene Storytelling
items.summary: Storyboards, worldbuilding, narrative scenes, and emotional pacing. / 生成分镜、世界观、故事场景和情绪节奏。
items.prompt:
Style Template: Scene Storytelling

Use when: Use for storyboards, worldbuilding, live scenes, and emotional narrative frames.

Prompt recipe:
- Define who, where, when, conflict, emotion, and camera framing.
- Use scene details to support narrative rather than decoration.

Avoid:
- Avoid generic fantasy backgrounds.
- Keep narrative cues visible in the frame.
guidance: Define who, where, when, conflict, emotion, and camera framing.
Use scene details to support narrative rather than decoration.
guidanceZh: 定义人物、地点、时间、冲突、情绪和机位。
让场景细节服务故事。
pitfalls: Avoid generic fantasy backgrounds.
Keep narrative cues visible in the frame.

items.title: History & Classical Themes
items.summary: Dynasty clothing, scroll narrative, poetry, and traditional motifs. / 生成朝代服饰、长卷叙事、诗词和传统题材。
items.prompt:
Style Template: History & Classical Themes

Use when: Use for ancient Chinese themes, scrolls, dynasty clothing, poetry visuals, and historical scenes.

Prompt recipe:
- Specify dynasty, clothing system, object references, layout format, and cultural mood.
- Use scroll, album page, or poster format deliberately.

Avoid:
- Avoid mixing dynasties when historical accuracy matters.
- Constrain random modern props.
guidance: Specify dynasty, clothing system, object references, layout format, and cultural mood.
Use scroll, album page, or poster format deliberately.
guidanceZh: 指定朝代、服饰制度、器物参考、版式和文化气质。
明确长卷、册页或海报形式。
pitfalls: Avoid mixing dynasties when historical accuracy matters.
Constrain random modern props.

items.title: Document & Publishing
items.summary: White papers, manuals, encyclopedic plates, and page systems. / 生成白皮书、手册、百科图鉴和页面系统。
items.prompt:
Style Template: Document & Publishing

Use when: Use for white papers, manuals, encyclopedic plates, report pages, and publication systems.

Prompt recipe:
- Define page size, columns, table of contents, figure system, and typography hierarchy.
- Use readable headings, tables, labels, and page rhythm.

Avoid:
- Avoid tiny dense text.
- Keep charts and captions aligned to the page grid.
guidance: Define page size, columns, table of contents, figure system, and typography hierarchy.
Use readable headings, tables, labels, and page rhythm.
guidanceZh: 定义页面尺寸、分栏、目录、图表系统和字体层级。
使用可读标题、表格、标签和页面节奏。
pitfalls: Avoid tiny dense text.
Keep charts and captions aligned to the page grid.

items.title: Concept Product Breakdown
items.summary: R&D boards, exploded views, mixed tasks, and special outputs. / 生成研发板、拆解图、混合任务和特殊输出。
items.prompt:
Style Template: Concept Product Breakdown

Use when: Use for experimental prompt tasks, R&D boards, exploded diagrams, and unusual visual systems.

Prompt recipe:
- Define the artifact type, components, labels, material logic, and final presentation format.
- Use clear callouts and a controlled technical style.

Avoid:
- Avoid unspecified mixed tasks.
- Keep labels short and component relationships visible.
guidance: Define the artifact type, components, labels, material logic, and final presentation format.
Use clear callouts and a controlled technical style.
guidanceZh: 定义产物类型、组件、标签、材质逻辑和展示格式。
使用清晰标注和受控技术风格。
pitfalls: Avoid unspecified mixed tasks.
Keep labels short and component relationships visible.
